title: Edda Vasse
notes: Commander Edda Vasse, the Citizen Nexus's Symbol: the protector. Her army requires the Citizen faction and brings her own unit, her two powers (Standing Order and Aid Station Permit) and the Aid Station that permit adds. Her campaign is campaigns/vasse.

card.title: Vasse
card.subtitle: Your Commander
card.description: Commander Edda Vasse leads from just behind the line. If she falls, the Nexus restores her as the next round opens.

content.notes: Her numbers, settled from the Experiments that tuned them (her health, 80, and By the Book's 25 percent less). Twice a trooper's health; she walks at the squads' pace and acts before the troopers beside her; she fires from just behind the melee, gently (at eight a shot she ended PERIMETER's first round before the Barracks's first trooper). By the Book guards: her units within a reach of 4, and she, take three quarters of a hit. Back as soon as the next round opens (roundsOut 0: the owner, 2026-10-13, "Base will just come back immediately after"). Not bought, so she takes no supply; the Nexus takes its Symbol back, so she leaves no salvage. Her glyph is the one on the Grid that is not a letter or a bracket, so she reads apart from every trooper.

card.title: Aid Station
card.subtitle: Heals units near it
card.description: A field post that heals your units near it, one at a time, through each Battle Round. Place it where the line will stand.

content.notes: What Aid Station Permit adds: repair, placed where the line will stand. It mends the units' layers only, never a building.

buildings.notes: Hers: what Aid Station Permit adds, and no level unlocks. A first guess of a cost, between the Turret's and the Hatchery's, with no balance claim.

powers.name: Standing Order
powers.description: By the Book reaches twice as far.
powers.notes: Her skill, wider: By the Book's reach doubles for the rest of the mission, on her card, on the map and in the battle.

powers.name: Aid Station Permit
powers.notes: Repair, placed where the line will stand: the Aid Station joins the build menu for the rest of the mission, after the buildings already there, so no hotkey moves.

appears: Commander on the Grid. Form up.
round-start: On my mark. That was it.
first-contact: By the book. The new book.
raid-arrives: Late arrivals. Not on my list.
unit-lost: Close the gap. I have the name.
falls: Hold it without me. Back soon.
